notes:
- Screens stop reading state they cannot see: every remaining always-on collector now follows the lifecycle, so a stopped composition stops mapping forty-odd flows.
- An open title page stops refreshing behind another app, and the chat-view comment poll stops with the window.
- A new catalogue search starts at the top instead of keeping the previous query's scroll offset.
- The statistics drawer, the filter bar summary and the category sort are computed once per input rather than once per pass.
- Count badges, Nova's stat values and the progress count crossfade without animating their container's width, so the rows and columns beside them stop re-measuring.
- Relation labels, tier shelf wording, Info chips, library headings, person fact chips and settings descriptions use a fixed case fold, so a Turkic locale cannot re-spell them.
- UI test tags no longer depend on the device language, and search placeholders recycle their grid slots.
- The arriving countdown and next-episode line are formatted once per airing rather than on every recomposition.
- The Info page's loading and arrival states hold still now: the hero's chip strip, the details grid, the studio row and the friends row expand or reserve their height instead of jumping, and the synopsis waits with shimmer lines rather than a spinner.
- Nova's episode countdown crossfades only when the sentence changes kind, so a page left open no longer fades the same line once a minute.
- The distribution bars, the entry capsule, the copy confirmations and the docked bar animate in the right phase: no per-frame layout, no ghost through the status bar.
- Cast, staff and relation rows recycle their slots, and the Info page's labels and roles use a fixed case fold.
